note: THE REJECTION CORPUS (§5.11). vectors.json describes days that are VALID; this describes inputs that must be REFUSED, and names every layer obliged to refuse them. Cases whose only layer is `api` are pending the auth and sync work, and the runner reports them as PENDING rather than letting them pass silently.
